title: Peacefulness Mod
description: This mod adds a brand new dimension to Minecraft, along with a few other additions.
body:
Please note: this mod hasn't been tested in multiplayer, so be warned!

Here are the additions to the mod as of the 7th of December 2025:

 - THE PEACEFUL DIMENSION -
   ![The Peaceful Portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a687f698e16ecaa8e24bca972a797e32cd0747d6.png)
- A new dimension accessed by finding a Peaceful Igniter and using it to light a dirt shaped portal.
- Sheep, Pigs, Allays and Chickens spawn here.
- The Peaceful House structure spawns here too! Has two adult sheep, one baby sheep, a villager and a chest to loot!
- Only has one biome currently: The Peaceful Grasslands. The plains but no hostile mobs.

- THE EXTREMIST - 
- A new villager occupation!
- Includes trades related to destruction and adventure.
- Job block is the Respawn Anchor.

- THE JAVA MONUMENT -
- A new structure which spawns in the overworld!
- Has the Java Block.
- Has a loot chest containing the portal igniter.

- THE JAVA BLOCK -
- A new block which is kinda useless

That's it! New content and Platforms will be added soon!
